description: This file defines the HasPermissionCondition class, implementing a conditional method operation for the OFBiz mini-language. It checks user permissions based on permissions and actions, and executes sub-operations accordingly.

classes.name: HasPermissionCondition
classes.description: Implements a permission-based conditional check within the mini-language, executing different sub-operations based on user permissions.

methods.name: checkCondition
methods.description: Evaluates whether the current user in the method context has the specified permission and action.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the sub-operations if the permission condition is true, or the else sub-operations if false.

methods.name: prettyPrint
methods.description: Outputs a human-readable description of the condition for debugging or logging.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the condition element.
